Lycanthropy.title: Lycanthropy
Lycanthropy.description: You have obtained the power to turn into a werewolf

first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with eop:dna_capsule{canine:"eop_true",display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Lycanthropy","color":"dark_gray","italic":false},{"text":" DNA Capsule","italic":false}]'}}
execute unless entity @s["vampirism:faction"="werewolves:werewolf","vampirism:level"=0..] run vampirism level werewolves:werewolf 1 @s

Secondary.Ability.title: Powerful Bite
Secondary.Ability.description: Sink your fangs into your prey. §dBattlemode §fmust be enabled via keybind. §dRight Click §fto use this ability

Transform.Unlock.title: Werewolf form
Transform.Unlock.description: Transform into your werewolf form. §dAbilities only work while transformed

last_tick_commands: execute if entity @s[tag=EOP.Werewolf] run scale set pehkui:eye_height 1.35
execute if entity @s[tag=EOP.Werewolf] run scale set pehkui:hitbox_height 1.5
execute unless entity @s[tag=EOP.Werewolf] run scale reset @s

Claw.Unlock.title: Sharp Claws
Claw.Unlock.description: Use your razor sharp claws to slash anything

Blood.Hunt.Unlock.description: Use your senses to track down creatures. §dWorks without being transformed

Summon.Unlock.title: Lupine Order
Summon.Unlock.description: Howl at the sky and summon three wolves to fight for you

Summon.Commands2.title: Frenzy
first_tick_commands: execute positioned ~1 ~ ~ run data modify entity @e[type=wolf,limit=1,sort=nearest] Owner set from entity @s UUID
execute positioned ~ ~ ~1 run data modify entity @e[type=wolf,limit=1,sort=nearest] Owner set from entity @s UUID
execute positioned ~-1 ~ ~ run data modify entity @e[type=wolf,limit=1,sort=nearest] Owner set from entity @s UUID
